entries.title: The south waterhole
entries.text: The acacia shade holds the last open water this side of the ridge.

entries.title: The north kopje
entries.text: A stone stack the lions use when the grass is high.

entries.title: The dry river
entries.text: It runs only after the long rain.

entries.title: Jasiri's pride
entries.text: Two adults and a half-grown cub hunt the waterhole.

entries.title: The zebra
entries.text: They drink in a line and leave when the grass moves.

entries.title: The buffalo
entries.text: A small herd keeps to the far bank.

entries.title: Under the acacia
entries.text: The first mark on the tree is older than this season.

entries.title: Dusk hunt
entries.text: One hunt, just after the light dropped.

entries.title: The first circle
entries.text: The old name for the land inside the ridge.
